headlines.title: Singapore-based investors now the top non-local buyers of Hong Kong office assets
headlines.summary:
Singapore-based investors have become the largest group of non-local buyers of commercial properties in Hong Kong, drawn by the sizeable correction in the prices of distressed assets amid a slump in the city’s office segment, according to Colliers.
The demand from Singapore was likely to remain steady in the coming months, given that the prices of office assets have declined by as much as 50 per cent, according to Thomas Chak, head of capital markets and investment services at the property...
headlines.title_zh: 新加坡投资者现已成为香港写字楼资产的最大海外买家
headlines.summary_zh: 高力国际表示，新加坡投资者已成为香港商业地产非本地买家中最大的群体，因香港写字楼板块低迷导致不良资产价格大幅回调，吸引了这些投资者。鉴于写字楼资产价格的走势，未来几个月新加坡的需求有望保持稳定。

headlines.title_en: Ministry of Commerce releases 'China's Position on the So-Called Overcapacity Issue'
headlines.summary_en: Ministry of Commerce on July 28 released 'China's Position on the So-Called 'Overcapacity' Issue,' clarifying facts and articulating China's policy stance on the matter. The document includes four chapters besides a preface and conclusion: comprehensively and objectively viewing global capacity and so-called 'excess'; perspectives on four pairs of relationships related to 'overcapacity'; China's commitment to building a modern industrial system in openness and cooperation; and jointly promoting an open, inclusive global industrial and supply chain cooperation pattern.

headlines.title: 荷兰国际：英国央行今年铁定不动 新首相承诺让市场捏一把汗
headlines.summary: 金十数据7月28日讯，荷兰国际集团经济学家认为英国央行最新预测将显示通胀“在今年下半年至明年初接近3%”，而这一水平仍在央行的容忍范围内。在此背景下，其基准预期是“英国央行在2026年全年按兵不动”，政策宽松将推迟至下一周期。荷兰国际银行表示，其“目前预测从2027年春季开始将有两次降息”，但强调这一路径“取决于秋季预算案中不会出现实质性财政刺激”。此外，英镑近期承压，因投资者对新首相伯纳姆支出承诺的融资来源持谨慎态度。伯纳姆宣布对交通票价和电费实施上限措施，引发市场对公共财政进一步承压的担忧——在2022年特拉斯财政风波之后，这是英国极为敏感的问题。

headlines.title_en: ING: Bank of England will definitely hold rates this year; new prime minister's promises make markets nervous
headlines.summary_en: Jin Shi Data July 28: ING economists believe the BoE's latest forecast will show inflation 'close to 3% in H2 this year to early next year,' still within the central bank's tolerance. In this context, their base case is 'BoE stays put throughout 2026,' with policy easing delayed to the next cycle. ING says it 'currently forecasts two rate cuts starting in spring 2027' but emphasizes this path depends on 'no substantial fiscal stimulus in the autumn budget.' Sterling is under pressure recently as investors are cautious about the financing source for PM Burnham's spending pledges. Burnham announced caps on transport fares and electricity bills, sparking concerns over further strain on public finances — an extremely sensitive issue in the UK after the 2022 Truss fiscal turmoil.

headlines.title: 上海市消保委：修复消费信任，携程还需根治“杀熟”顽症
headlines.summary: 近日，国家市场监管总局作出行政处罚，对携程集团滥用市场支配地位实施垄断行为罚没合计51.79亿元，并责令平台全面落实合规整改，标志着在线旅游行业迈入深度规范化治理新阶段。上海市消保委发文指出，市场良序的形成，离不开多元协同的社会监督力量，监督目光更要持续紧盯大数据杀熟这一民生顽疾。要充分激发消费者组织平台作用，支持消费者组织常态化开展消费体察与调查，持续曝光算法价格乱象，凝聚全社会抵制价格歧视的广泛共识与合力。持续畅通一体化投诉举报渠道，简化价格差异线索提交方式，方便消费者上传多账号、多设备对比凭证；健全有奖举报机制，重点收集同房型价差显著、跨境酒店价格

headlines.title_en: Shanghai Consumer Protection Commission: To restore consumer trust, Trip.com must fundamentally address dynamic pricing issues.
headlines.summary_en: The State Administration for Market Regulation recently imposed an administrative penalty on Trip.com Group, fining and confiscating a total of 5.179 billion yuan for abusing market dominance in monopolistic practices, and ordered the platform to fully implement compliance rectification, marking a new phase of deep standardized governance in the online travel industry. The Shanghai Consumer Council issued a statement noting that a well-ordered market requires diverse collaborative social oversight, with sustained scrutiny particularly on algorithmic price discrimination, a persistent public concern. It calls for fully leveraging consumer organization platforms, supporting regular consumer experience surveys, continuously exposing algorithmic price irregularities, and building broad consensus to resist price discrimination. It also urges streamlining integrated complaint channels, simplifying submission of price discrepancy evidence for consumers to upload multi-account and multi-device comparisons, and strengthening reward-based reporting mechanisms to focus on significant price disparities for the same room type and cross-border hotel pricing.

headlines.title: 中原粮仓长出算力肌肉
headlines.summary: 【中原粮仓长出算力肌肉】一个农业大省，正在影响全国的算力版图。2026年上半年，河南交出了一份亮眼成绩单：GDP达3.35万亿元，增长5%、高于全国0.3个百分点，在全国、经济大省和中部六省中均向前进位。值得注意的是，河南规上高技术制造业、战略性新兴产业增加值分别增长26.1%、13.2%。数字增长的背后，作为看不见的基座，算力“肌肉”正在中原大地的土壤之下悄然生长，并为河南的产业升级注入动能。

headlines.title_en: Central Plains granary flexes computing muscle
headlines.summary_en: [Central plains granary grows computing muscle] An agricultural province is reshaping China's computing landscape. In H1 2026, Henan delivered a strong performance: GDP of 3.35 trillion yuan, up 5%, 0.3 percentage points above the national average, moving up in rankings nationwide, among major economies, and in central six provinces. Notably, Henan's value-added output from above-scale high-tech manufacturing and strategic emerging industries grew 26.1% and 13.2% respectively. Behind these digital gains, computing 'muscle,' an invisible infrastructure, is quietly growing beneath the central plains soil, injecting momentum into Henan's industrial upgrading.
